title: Yann LeCun's AMI Labs raises $1.03 billion to build world models
summary: AMI Labs (Advanced Machine Intelligence), the AI startup co-founded by Turing Award laureate Yann LeCun, has raised $1.03 billion in a seed round at a $3.5 billion valuation. The company is building world models based on LeCun's JEPA (Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture) framework, which aims to create AI systems that understand the physical world. The round was co-led by Bezos Expeditions, Cathay Innovation, Greycroft, Hiro Capital, and HV Capital.

title: French AI startup AMI announces $1bn raised in funding
summary: French AI startup AMI (Advanced Machine Intelligence) has announced raising over $1 billion in seed funding, making it one of the largest seed rounds in European startup history. Founded by Yann LeCun alongside a team of former Meta FAIR researchers, AMI is developing 'universal intelligent systems' based on world models. The company is headquartered in Paris with offices in New York, Montreal, and Singapore.

title: Yann LeCun's AMI Labs secures $1B+ in bet on world models
